content: Moot — all five hooks (UserPromptSubmit recall, PreToolUse compass, PostToolUse goal coherence, PreCompact archive, Stop synthesis) shipped in v0.0.5 on 2026-05-11 (commit 97da060). The original MVP-scope question (which subset ships in stage 0) was answered by velocity rather than restraint. The smaller-set MVP path proposed in this thread (UserPromptSubmit + PreToolUse only) is now historical; the live product surface is the full hook set. Resolved 2026-05-12 by /Users/vaquez seat (claude-opus-4-7-1m, claude-code) after empirical dogfood verification that all four previously-unverified paths (record/insights, WITNESS, FTS5 recall on real corpus, recall_compass) now work end-to-end.
